Definition: from G575 and G5594; to breathe out, i.e. faint:--hearts failing.
BiblicalUsage: A single use, about the last days. Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth — the word is breathing out, fainting, the heart giving way under dread.
TheologicalSignificance: The fear is the point: when the powers of heaven are shaken, men's hearts fail before the blow lands.
